messages:
deploy-bot: deploy window open for release 2026.03.07-r1 -> prod-gamma. gates: slo-checks, smoke, canary routing. tagging @oncall :eyes:

sre-bot: automated check running: p95 latency, error-rate, 5xx count, saturation. first pass in 30s.

Alex: seeing p95 on embed.service climb to ~620ms for last 90s. not across all hosts, mostly pool-b.

Maya: error-rate for embed.service up 0.5% -> 1.4% (5m). requests failing with grpc code 13 and occasional timeouts.

Jordan: logs show this stack: ```
worker.ts: request timeout after 450ms
model_client.go: read deadline exceeded
kvcache: miss spike on prefix key shard-3
```

Sam: hmm could be kv cache eviction + a bad quantized kernel on pool-b. we recently pushed model-variant v2-quant to pool-b in canary.

Liz: suggest we hold canary -> do not promote. can we pin prod-gamma routing to previous model-variant (v2-q8) while we investigate? :thumbsup:

Maya: +1. If we pin routing we can keep the infra changes but avoid customer impact.

deploy-bot: command to pin routing for prod-gamma: ```
redwood route update prod-gamma --service embed.service --model v2-q8 --sticky true --reason "pin after p95 spike"
```

Alex: running that now. rolling config to 3 regions. watching dashboards.

sre-bot: alert suppressed for embed.service p95 spike (ticket: #E-3247) while routing pin in progress. automatic unsuppress in 15m.

Alex: pin applied to prod-gamma, traffic shifted to v2-q8 for embed.service. p95 dropped to ~190ms after 40s. errors trending back to baseline (~0.2%). :relieved:

Jordan: let's capture rollout logs and open a short postmortem for the model-variant change. action items: (1) revert kernel tuning on pool-b, (2) expand pre-prod kvcache stress test, (3) add variant smoke check to canary gating.

Sam: I'll own (1) and (2). Maya can you add (3) to the release checklist?

Maya: on it. adding smoke check: `variant-smoke: simple embeds through >3 pools, p95<300ms, errs<0.5%`

Liz: good call. leaving deploy window open but blocking promote step until postmortem. tagging #product for release notes update.

deploy-bot: deploy window remains open with promote blocked. will post final status at window close. :white_check_mark:
